zh.title: Aviation Capital Group向空中巴士訂購75架A320neo系列客機
zh.summary: ACG訂購75架A320neo系列客機，預計2032至2035年間交付
body: Aviation Capital Group（ACG）向空中巴士訂購75架A320neo系列客機。AeroTime報導，這是ACG這家美國租賃公司的歷來最大筆飛機採購。ACG表示，這批飛機預定於2032年至2035年間交付。
協議也包含在A320neo系列不同機型間轉換的權利。ACG表示，其投資組合策略著重於航空公司全球需求最高的新技術窄體客機。空中巴士指出，這筆訂單使ACG對該系列的歷來訂單總數達190架。

en.title: Airbus secures ACG order for 75 A320neo family aircraft
en.summary: Aviation Capital Group orders 75 Airbus A320neo family aircraft, with deliveries scheduled for 2032–2035.
body: Airbus has secured an order from Aviation Capital Group (ACG) for 75 A320neo family aircraft. AeroTime described it as the US lessor’s largest aircraft purchase to date. ACG said the aircraft are scheduled to arrive between 2032 and 2035.

The agreement includes conversion rights among variants within the A320neo family, AeroTime reported. ACG said its portfolio strategy focuses on new-technology narrowbody aircraft that are in strong demand with airlines globally. Airbus said the order brings ACG’s total historical orders for the type to 190 aircraft.

zh.title: 土耳其航空與CFM International簽署備忘錄 涵蓋300多具引擎及長期支援
zh.summary: 土耳其航空與CFM簽署備忘錄，涵蓋300多具引擎及長期支援
body: 土耳其航空與CFM International於2026年10月16日在伊斯坦堡簽署諒解備忘錄。初步協議涵蓋300多具LEAP-1B引擎，並包括備用引擎；另包括為超過600具機隊引擎提供長期服務支援。
雙方另原則同意，由CFM International為土耳其航空整個LEAP-1B引擎機隊提供長期服務。備忘錄亦納入一項物料服務協議，支持在土耳其設立引擎維修、修理及大修設施；土耳其航空旗下AJet使用的引擎也將納入服務範圍。

en.title: Turkish Airlines signs CFM MOU for 300-plus LEAP-1B engines and support
en.summary: Turkish Airlines signs CFM memorandum covering LEAP-1B engines and long-term fleet support
body: Turkish Airlines and CFM International signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on October 16, 2026, in Istanbul. The preliminary agreement covers more than 300 LEAP-1B engines, including spares, and long-term service support for over 600 fleet engines.

The two sides also agreed in principle to long-term services for Turkish Airlines’ entire LEAP-1B engine fleet. The MOU includes a material services agreement to support establishing an engine maintenance, repair and overhaul facility in Turkey. Engines used by Turkish Airlines subsidiary AJet would also be covered.

zh.title: 達美航空與泰國航空最新商務艙將採用相同核心座椅
zh.summary: 達美航空與泰國航空將在最新商務艙產品採用相同核心座椅
body: Simple Flying報導，達美航空與泰國航空將在各自最新的商務艙產品中納入相同的核心座椅。這項說法描述的是兩家公司未來產品中的座椅安排，並將共同採用核心座椅列為兩者的相同之處。
報導摘要另稱，兩者「難以區分」。現有說法的重點是兩家航空公司將在最新商務艙產品中採用相同核心座椅，且報導以難以區分形容兩者；這項安排以未來式呈現。

en.title: Delta Air Lines and Thai Airways to Use the Same Core Business-Class Seat
en.summary: Delta Air Lines and Thai Airways will use the same core seat in their latest business-class products.
body: Simple Flying reports that Delta Air Lines and Thai Airways will incorporate the same core seat into their latest business-class products. The summary also describes the two as hard to tell apart. It presents the shared core seat as part of each airline’s latest product and uses future wording for the planned incorporation.

The report’s stated comparison is that the two are difficult to distinguish, alongside the shared-seat claim. Its account concerns the core seat in the airlines’ latest business-class products and describes its incorporation as a future development.

zh.title: 巴基斯坦國際航空簽署波音777客艙翻新協議
zh.summary: 巴基斯坦國際航空簽約翻新部分波音777客艙，五架納入計畫
body: 巴基斯坦國際航空已簽署一項客艙現代化協議，涵蓋部分波音777。計畫將分階段進行，協議確認納入五架波音777，另有四架的選項。
改裝範圍包括安裝全平躺式商務艙座椅、翻新現有經濟艙座椅，以及在客艙各處加入新的60W座椅電源供應（ISPS）和乘客服務系統（PSS）設備。計畫也涵蓋工程支援、認證、材料採購與物流、專案管理及技術協調。

en.title: Pakistan International Airlines signs Boeing 777 cabin refurbishment deal
en.summary: Pakistan International Airlines signs a phased cabin refurbishment agreement covering five Boeing 777s.
body: Pakistan International Airlines has signed an agreement for a phased cabin modernization program covering selected Boeing 777 aircraft. The agreement includes five confirmed aircraft, with options for an additional four.

The refurbishment scope includes full-flat Business Class seats and refurbishment of existing Economy Class seating. It also includes new 60W In-Seat Power Supply and Passenger Service System equipment throughout the cabin. The program encompasses engineering support, certification activities, material procurement and logistics, project management, and technical coordination.

zh.title: 俄羅斯多座機場限制運作 航班仍有延誤
zh.summary: 俄羅斯多座機場於10月15日至16日限制運作，部分航班仍延誤。
body: Interfax報導，莫斯科的 Sheremetyevo Airport（SVO）、Domodedovo Airport（DME）、Vnukovo Airport及Zhukovsky Airport（ZIA）於2026年10月15日至16日受到運作限制，措施是為了「確保飛航安全」。Interfax另報導，聖彼得堡的 Pulkovo Airport（LED）在夜間暫停航班運作。俄羅斯媒體報導，總計有22座機場受到運作限制。
FlightRadar24資料顯示，機場運作其後已恢復，但Vnukovo、Sheremetyevo及Pulkovo仍有後續延誤。另據TASS於10月16日報導，俄羅斯國防部稱烏克蘭在夜間向各地發射644架無人機，其中57架朝莫斯科方向飛行。這項無人機數量與方向的說法由TASS歸於俄羅斯國防部；報導並未在此處說明它與各機場限制措施之間的直接關聯。

en.title: Russian Airports Restrict Operations Amid Overnight Drone Activity
en.summary: Several Russian airports restricted operations, with residual delays reported at three airports.
body: According to Interfax, Moscow’s Sheremetyevo Airport (SVO), Domodedovo Airport (DME), Vnukovo Airport and Zhukovsky Airport (ZIA) faced restrictions between October 15 and 16, 2026, to “ensure flight safety.” Interfax also reported that St Petersburg Pulkovo Airport (LED) suspended flight operations overnight. Russian media reported restricted operations at 22 airports in total.

Operations have since resumed, but residual delays remained at Vnukovo, Sheremetyevo and Pulkovo, according to FlightRadar24 data. Separately, TASS reported on October 16 that Russia’s Defense Ministry said Ukraine had launched 644 drones across regions overnight, including 57 heading towards Moscow. The report does not establish a direct link between that drone activity and the airport restrictions.

zh.title: 漢莎航空要求部分飛往法蘭克福航班攜帶額外燃油
zh.summary: 漢莎航空要求部分飛往法蘭克福的航班因供應疑慮攜帶額外燃油
body: Simple Flying報導，漢莎航空要求部分飛往法蘭克福的航班攜帶額外燃油，理由是對供應的疑慮。報導摘要並提到，這則消息出現在今年較早時期的航班削減之後；摘要稱，先前削減航班是由燃油價格危機所驅動。
目前報導所述的措施，是要求部分飛往法蘭克福的航班攜帶額外燃油。摘要提及的先前航班削減則與燃油價格危機有關；報導沒有表示先前削減航班造成這次額外燃油安排。

en.title: Lufthansa orders extra fuel on select Frankfurt-bound flights amid supply concerns
en.summary: Lufthansa orders extra fuel on select Frankfurt-bound flights amid supply concerns
body: Simple Flying reports that Lufthansa has ordered select flights bound for Frankfurt to carry extra fuel over concerns about supply. The source's summary says the news follows flight cuts earlier in the year and attributes those cuts to the fuel price crisis.

The reported measure concerns extra fuel on select Frankfurt-bound flights. The summary separately describes earlier flight cuts as driven by the fuel price crisis; it does not say those cuts caused the new instruction.
